channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: You do not face adversity alone
item.description: From NFL stars to Jesus’ first disciples, this reflection shows how faith in the crucified Christ turns fear and adversity into courage — and reminds you that you never face trials alone.

item.title: MJB fund opens scholarship applications
item.description: Applications open for 2026 Maggie J. Bryant Scholarship Fund, offering up to $1,500 for Crenshaw, Covington and Pike County seniors and freshmen; apply by March 31.

item.title: In Thatcher's spirit, for Alabama's people
item.description: Lieutenant governor candidate Nicole Jones Wadsworth invokes Margaret Thatcher's courage as she outlines plans for jobs, infrastructure, rural healthcare and public safety in Alabama.

item.title: Kiwanians turn focus to Valentine's Day, honors luncheon
item.description: Luverne Kiwanis uses its Feb. 3 meeting to spotlight Valentine’s Day, student scholarships and community service, inviting locals to learn more at noon sessions at the Chicken Shack.

item.title: When texting is their love language
item.description: Overwhelmed by constant texts from someone you like? Amy explains why it's a communication-style mismatch, how to set boundaries and what their response reveals about compatibility.

item.title: Make-A-Wish launches license plate campaign
item.description: Make-A-Wish Alabama launches specialty license plate, sending $41.50 per tag to wishes for kids with critical illnesses; 1,000 pre-commitments needed to begin production.

item.title: Fight against hopeless emotions
item.description: When life’s worst hits — illness, job loss, divorce — hopelessness can pull you into depression. This piece urges you to fight that emotion and keep believing in tomorrow.

item.title: Crenshaw scholars recognized for UA honors
item.description: UA honors Crenshaw County scholars on fall 2025 dean’s and president’s lists

item.title: Policy council working toward teen, family programs
item.description: Crenshaw County Children’s Policy Council eyes expanded book programs, teen events and a new youth center, introducing ambassadors and scholarships to better support local kids.

item.title: ‘Alabama Soul’ brings Muscle Shoals to Opry House
item.description: Alabama Soul launches its 2026 tour Feb. 13 at the historic Georgiana Opry House, bringing a live tribute to the Muscle Shoals sound and Alabama’s soul and gospel roots.
